content.text: Sales were 10% lower this month than last month. Can we conclude the marketing campaign failed?

raw_text:
Not from sales data alone. A 10% decline shows correlation, not whether the campaign caused it.

To assess the campaign, compare actual sales against a credible counterfactual—what sales likely would have been without the campaign. Consider:

- Seasonality and normal month-to-month variation
- Pricing, promotions, inventory, and distribution changes
- Competitor activity and broader market conditions
- Campaign reach, engagement, leads, and conversion rates
- Sales by exposed vs. unexposed customers or regions
- Whether the campaign’s objective or impact window was longer-term

A control group, A/B test, or historical/forecast benchmark would provide stronger evidence. The campaign might have failed, but it also may have prevented an even larger decline or not yet had time to affect sales.
